lines.text: Do not boast about tomorrow, and let a stranger praise you, not your own mouth.
Aggravation from a fool outweighs stone and sand, and the wounds of a friend are faithful.
A man who wanders from his home is like a bird that strays from its tree.
The prudent see danger and take cover, and as iron sharpens iron, so one man sharpens another.
A man is tested by the battles he fights, and a fool's folly will not depart from him.
